name: boxdawn-guard
description: Judges each Bash and PowerShell command before Claude runs it: deny, ask, or no decision.

api_key.title: Boxdawn API key (optional)
api_key.description: With a key, the guard fetches signed rule updates from Boxdawn at session start (the request carries the key only). Leave empty to use the fixed rules with no network connection.

keep_blocks_local.title: Keep the block record on this machine
keep_blocks_local.description: On a paid plan the guard sends its block record (tool, deny or ask, rule ids, where the target sits; never a command or a path) to Boxdawn at session start, for your team's view. Turn this on to keep it on this machine only.
